svg.title: Scene Calibration — Core Code & Implementation
svg.desc: Dense, asymmetric English newspaper code page: six implemented systems, exact GDScript source excerpts and four small in-game photographs. Source gaps and visual wrapping are explicit. Editable text and linked public source files.
